title: Calling `load()` or `load_threaded_request()` in game launched from the Editor can freeze the main thread
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.2, 4.7.0
Didn't test it in 4.7.1

### System information

Windows 11, RTX 2060

### Issue description

Sometimes when using load() or load_threaded_request(), with or without Threads, the game freezes. It may resume when switching back to the game window or it may remain stuck forever. It doesn't throw “Not Responding” errors from Windows, the game simply becomes unresponsive and you can't do anything until you close it.

This doesn't seem to happen in Release builds, although it could simply occur much less frequently and so far no issues.

Here the game resumes when switching windows and I used the load_threaded_request() method, notice when the output logs "Scene 1 loaded, Scene 2 loaded" show up .

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4b0e5a19-7f01-49c3-8a4e-c6e2b5f0f088

### Steps to reproduce

Run the scene and if it loads as it should, close the game and keep trying. If the game freezes, try to switch back to the editor, check the logs and switch back to the game again.

Use USE_THREAD true/false to check both methods.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[resource-loader-freeze.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33001179/resource-loader-freeze.zip)
